left.title: Yihew Izemralehu Leimebete
left.title_english: I will forever sing for my Lady
left.description:
Original song: Yihew Ezemiralew Le Emebete
Singer: Liqe Lisanat Cherenet Senay

I will forever sing for my Lady 
For she has filled my home with homily
Because she’s visited me through this wretched life
I will praise the Virgin until the end of time 

From my sorrowful face she soothed away my tears 
I’m made to magnify her with songs and prayers 
With misery and pain I no longer suffer 
Into my home she came the mother of wonder

The disarray of life crumbling around me 
She cleared it all away restored my sanity 
She listens to my pleas my appeals and my cries
With her intercession my prayers will arise 

No longer do I see through a clouded vision 
My eyes have been healed by her hands of compassion 
When I appeal to her with sorrow and despair 
Immaculate is she, to the world I’ll declare 

Day and night I lament with a heavy burden 
From drowning she saved me so I won’t be saddened 
For she has pulled me free from the clench of my sins 
To her eternally I will raise up my hands 

ይኸው እዘምራለሁ ለእመቤቴ 
የፍቅሯ በረከት ገብቶ ቤቴ
ስለጎበኘችው ጎስቋላው ሕይወቴን
አመሰግናለሁ ድንግል እመቤቴን

Website: https://www.ahadustudios.com/ 

Instagram: https://instagram.com/ahadu.studios

Tiktok: https://tiktok.com/@ahadu.studios

Facebook: https://facebook.com/ahadustudios

right.title: Selam Leki
right.description: This mezmur is a hymn of veneration to the Virgin Mary, greeting her with titles drawn from the Old Testament and sacred tradition. She is symbolically identified with holy objects and events such as Noah’s Ark, Aaron’s rod, Gideon’s fleece, Jacob’s ladder, and the manna of heaven—each pointing to her role in bearing Christ. The chant emphasizes her purity, divine selection, and her place as the Mother of God (Eme Egziabher). Through poetic praise, the faithful honor her as the fulfillment of biblical types and approach her with reverence, asking for her blessings and intercession.

right.title: Qidus Gebriel
right.description:
#የመዝሙርግጥም
ወደእኛ መጣልን ከአምላክ ተላከና
ድንግልን ሊጎበኝ ይዞ የብሥራት ዜና
የስሙ ትርጓሜ ሰውና አምላክ 
ቅዱስ ገብርኤል አብሳሬ መልአክ 
ዘማ……………… 
በሰማይ በሆነው በዓለመ መላእክት 
ሳጥናኤል ሲነሳ ሽቶ አምላክነት 
መከፋፈል ሲሆን ደንግጦ ልባቸው 
የሳጥናኤል ሀሳብ ያላጠራጠረው 
             ባለንበት እንቁም ብሎ የተናገረው 
            ነገደ መላእክትን ያረጋጋ እርሱ ነው 
ዘማ……………… 
በባቢሎን አገር ያሉ ሦስት ሕጻናት 
ለፈጣሪያቸው የታመኑ በእውነት 
ለአገሩ ጣኦት አንሰግድም ስላሉ 
በጨካኙ ንጉሥ በእሳት  ተጣሉ 
           የእሳቱ ወላፈን ከቶ እንዳይነካቸው 
          ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ወርዶ ቆመ በመሐላቸው 
ዘማ…………… 
ቂርቆስ ኢየሉጣ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ 
ስለስሙ ኖረው ምስክር ሊሆኑ 
በፈጣሪያቸው በመታመናቸው 
መሰደድ መሸሽ ሆነ እጣ ፋንታቸው 
            በሰማዕትነት እስክታርፍ ነፍሳቸው 
            ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ነው ወርዶ ያበረታቸው 
ዘማ………… 
የአዳም ተስፋው ቃል መፈፀሚያው ሲደርስ 
ክንፉን እያማታ ገባ ቤተ-መቅደስ 
የአምላክን ሰው መሆን ነገራት ለድንግል 
ትፀንሻለሽ ብሎ አካላዊው ቃል 
       ወልደ አምላክ ክርስቶስ ወዳንቺ ይመጣል 
      ዓለሙን ለማዳን ካንቺ ይወለዳል 
ዘማ……………… 
ዘወትር የሚቆም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት 
ስለእኛ ሚማልድ ከአምላክ ምሕረት 
የኃጥኡን መመለስ እጅግ ሚያስደስተው 
የመላእክት አለቃ ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ነው
         ባለንበት እንቁም ብሎ የተናገረው
         ነገደ መላእክትን ያረጋጋ እርሱ ነው

ግጥም ዲያቆን አሽናፊ መታፈሪያ 
ዜማ  ዘማሪ ዲያቆን ፀጋሥላሴ 
   ድምፅ አጃቢ  ዘማሪት ሩት ደመላሽ 
                   ዘማሪት  ሰላማዊት መላኩ 
                    ዘማሪት   በጸሎት አስማረ
                    ዘማሪ የአብቃል ደሳለኝ

right.title: Qana Zegelila
right.description:
Original song: Qana ZeGelila
Original Singer: Kesis Mindaye Birhanu


Cana of Galilee (2) in the matrimony
Virgin we have found you with divinity 
Our Lord we have found you with our Lady

Invited were the crowds flooding through the foyer
Celebrating they ate emptied the wine chamber 
Our Holy Virgin the Mother of our Lord 
For your mediation it is you they implored

With you in attendance ashamed they will not feel
Nothing is beneath you fill with wine their barrel
“They have no wine” you said to your son our Lord 
It is our Mother we cherish and adore 

Divinity of Lord that was unveiled to us
How fortunate it was the house of Dokimas 
And today in the home of this grand unity 
Blessings have spilled to us, with His humility 

Transfigured was the wine when it was just water 
In Cana Galilee our eyes did not falter 
If we ensure that He remains within our midst
Good wine will overflow as written in the scripts

Website: https://www.ahadustudios.com/ 

Instagram: https://instagram.com/ahadu.studios

Tiktok: https://tiktok.com/@ahadu.studios

Facebook: https://facebook.com/ahadustudios
